title: Fork and deleted-fork pull requests never take a variable-selected runner

needles: A pull request whose fork was deleted is a fork too.

installed_sdk.rationale: This changes only which runner a CI job lands on for fork pull requests, its documentation, and a lint; no SDK header, target, symbol, or installed artifact changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI command, flag, or output contract changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No runtime operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The change routes CI runners and does not publish a design-time capability.
